intentComment: No `//deploy:ratchet-mainnet` doc-comment in package.json. Intent comes from the @notice on DeployMainnetNudgeRatchet.s.sol: single-broadcast mainnet deployment that promotes story 068's local NudgeRatchet integration (DeployMocks.s.sol Phase 3.7) to mainnet — deploys five contracts (RatchetBatchNFTMinter, NudgeRatchet, NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook, RatchetNFTStaker(NFTStakerPriceScaled), MintPageView), wires them, registers the NudgeRatchet dispatcher (auto-assigns index 7; index 6 is the permanently-disabled bugged pooler), and redeploys+repoints MintPageView so the mint page surfaces the new ratchet path. The post-broadcast Node patcher fills the four ratchet address fields (zero-placeholder only) and UPDATE-replaces MintPageView in mainnet-addresses.ts. The patcher header tags this story 069.

preview.note: PREVIEW_MODE branches the script: vm.startPrank(OWNER_ADDRESS) instead of vm.startBroadcast(); progress file is NOT written; pre/post Node stages do NOT run (only the bare forge invocation is in the preview npm key).

broadcast.note: Hardware-wallet (Ledger) signed at HD path m/44'/60'/46'/0/0 -> owner 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6. --skip-simulation means forge will NOT pre-simulate; require()-based safety gates inside run() are the only guard. --slow serializes txs.

pre.note: Pure timestamped copy of mainnet-addresses.ts before broadcast. No on-chain effect.

post.note: Patches address keys from the broadcast CREATE txs. Aborts (exit 2) unless progress.deploymentStatus === 'completed'. Exit codes: 1 broadcast missing/bad, 2 progress missing/not-completed, 3 expected CREATE not found, 4 collision (non-zero placeholder) or field-not-found.

configConstants.RATCHET_NUDGE_TOKEN: USDS (must differ from USDC payment token)
